typeScale: headline ~12% of canvas height, proof name ~4%, proof title ~2.5%
colourBlocking: The canvas is dominated by a soft gradient background. A large, central white rounded rectangle contains all primary content. Text is dark, with one specific element highlighted by a light pill background. The human portrait adds a natural skin tone and clothing.
negativeSpace: Ample negative space within the white container, especially around the quote and between the quote and the bottom elements. This allows the text and human face to breathe and stand out, making the ad feel clean and uncluttered.
eyePath: Quote device -> Headline (main text) -> Highlighted offer -> Human face (smile) -> Proof (name) -> Logo.
whyItWins: This layout wins by clearly presenting a strong, quantifiable benefit from a credible human source within a clean, focused design, leveraging social proof and a clear value proposition.
